text:
A 13 year old and a physician can walk the same case. Both should learn something.

That is my test for whether the teaching is right.

If the only way to learn is to already have the vocabulary, it is not teaching. It is gatekeeping. And medicine has enough of that already.

The body is not a secret. It is a system. And any person willing to walk through a case and pay attention should be able to follow what is happening and why.

The AI attending reads the room. Sometimes you need one line. Sometimes the whole mechanism. You choose how deep to go. The teaching meets you where you are.

That is what Caleb did. He did not speak above me. He spoke to where my hands were. And he let the problem do most of the teaching.
